syllabus_topics: Representation of SISO systems by transfer function
Modeling of dynamic systems as energy converters: flow, potential, accumulators, dissipators
Application to mechanical, electrical, fluidic and thermal systems: analogies between systems
Analysis of dynamic systems of first order, second order, with zeros, higher order, non-minimum phase, stable and unstable, and system reduction
Frequency responses: Bode and polar diagrams
Sensors for position, velocity, acceleration, proximity, force, torque, flow, level, temperature
Actuators in a control loop: servomotors and pneumatic actuators
assessment_rules: The final grade is 0.5 * (Average of Best 5 Lab Grades) + 0.5 * (Best Exam Grade). To pass the course, the best exam grade must be >= 8 and the average of the best 5 lab grades must be >= 10. If either condition is not met, the final grade is Fail.
bibliography: K. Ogata, Modern Control Engineering, 5th Edition, Prentice Hall, 2010 (main)
D. Valério, Lecture Notes on Signals, Systems and Control (course lecture notes), -, 2025 (main)
